name: apple-calendar
description: Read and create Apple Calendar events (including recurring ones) from Claude.
long_description: A small local MCP server built on EventKit. It lets Claude list your calendars, read upcoming events and create new events with location, notes and recurrence rules. macOS only; the first use asks for calendar access.

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: List all calendars with account and writability.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List upcoming events, optionally filtered by calendar.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create an event, optionally recurring, with location and notes.
